description.p: Grabr is a local-first download manager featuring chunked parallel downloading, resumable transfers, and automatic database synchronization across platforms.

ul.li: Modern, elegant graphite UI built with Rust and egui
Automatic database synchronization with Grabr CLI and background daemon
YouTube combined video and audio download format selector
System tray integration and desktop notifications
Parallel chunked downloads for maximum speed
